The Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) is required to implement post market safety activities in
accordance with domestic(Japanese) regulatory requirements. Per the Ministerial Ordinance on Good
Vigilance Practice (MHLW MO135) which is stipulated as the requirement for licensing MAH under
Article 23-2-2 of Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices Act.

As directed by the MAH in Japan, for Foreign Experience Reports (FER) i.e., events that occur outside of
Japan, the OU complaint handling unit will inform the MAH of the potentially reportable event after
completion of the investigation by assessing the initial FER as ‘potential’. This is in alignment with the
Ministerial Ordinance on Standards for Manufacturing Control and Quality Control for Medical Devices
and In-Vitro Diagnostics" (MHLW MO169), Chapter 3 Additional Requirements Regarding Manufacturing
Control and Quality Control of Medical Devices, Article 69and Medical Device Reporting Manual (Fuguai-
hohkokusho-toh-no Tebiki) (published by the Pharmaceutical Safety Division, Pharmaceutical and
Environmental Health Bureau, Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare Cooperation (Japan)
Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices Agency, Medical Device Quality Control).The MAH is responsible for
regulatory reporting in Japan and will herein be referred to as Region Complaint Unit (RCU). Per local
Japanese regulations, the MAH Aware Date is the date the MAH obtain or learn of the event
information. This is per the Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Act Article 68-10 (1).Note: MAH has
visibility to potentially reportable events when the FER decision is set to ‘potential’.
